scope: Proposition 3.4 (Comparison for three-quarter supports) of the manuscript “An Isolated Particle Pole for the Two-Dimensional O(3) Spin Field” (preprints/An-Isolated-Particle-Pole-for-the-Two-Dimensional-O3-Spin-Field-October-4-2026/o3-particle-pole.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 215 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 302c6b61d389fbb9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let w = wk be sufficiently large. If the support of a bounded observable F has a lift contained in a rectangle of extent at most 3w/4 in each coordinate, then |Etor,N;w,wF − Eplane,N F| ≤ C∥F∥∞e−cw , (3.8) uniformly in N ≥ K0. The assertion holds for bounded measurable observables. Comparison of this square with its infinite-time cylinder requires only the time extent bound.
